verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only built-in automations that react to events: forwarded or uploaded bills become draft bills, JAX categorizes and matches incoming bank transactions, duplicate bills are flagged, and invoice opens are tracked. Nothing shows users defining their own rules or triggers. Missing for 10: user-defined rule/trigger configuration (e.g. bank rules or workflow rules), webhook or event-subscription docs for custom actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
